name: Cryptography Algorithms Implementation
tagline: A Python internship project demonstrating AES, RSA, and hashing algorithms with examples and unit tests.
description: Developed during an internship with Codec Technologies, this project provides hands-on implementations of core cryptography algorithms. It demonstrates symmetric encryption, asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, and hashing through a modular Python codebase, example scripts, documentation, and tests.
problemStatement: Provide practical demonstrations of core cryptography algorithms in a clean, modular Python project with runnable examples and tests.
solution: A Python project implementing AES encryption and decryption, RSA encryption and decryption with public/private key pairs and digital signatures, and hashing algorithms, supported by example scripts and Pytest unit tests.

features.name: AES symmetric encryption
features.details: Encrypts and decrypts data using a secret key.

features.name: RSA asymmetric cryptography
features.details: Uses public/private key-pair encryption and supports digital signatures.

features.name: Unit tests
features.details: Uses Pytest to verify algorithm behavior.

features.name: Example scripts
features.details: Includes separate demo scripts for AES, RSA, and hashing.

features.name: Modular project structure
features.details: Separates symmetric, asymmetric, and hashing implementations.

testing.details: The README states that unit tests are included to verify algorithm correctness.

learningOutcomes: Implemented AES and RSA in Python
Worked with hashing algorithms for secure storage
Practiced modular code organization using src/ and tests/
Improved debugging and testing skills with Pytest
acknowledgments: Codec Technologies for the internship opportunity
